Infrared Sauna in Salem, WI

Matrix offers private infrared sauna sessions in Salem, Wisconsin for guests who want warmth, relaxation and an easy recovery-focused add-on to their routine.

A quiet place to warm up and unwind.

Infrared sauna uses radiant heat in a private wellness setting. Matrix presents sauna as a general wellness and relaxation service rather than a medical treatment or detox cure.

Use sauna as a standalone wellness visit or pair it thoughtfully.

Sauna can fit before or after selected recovery services when scheduling and individual comfort allow.

Straightforward sessions without the spa-day time commitment.

Square currently lists Infrared Sauna (Add-On) as a private 30-minute appointment for $35. The Custom Therapeutic Massage booking flow also offers a 30-minute sauna enhancement for $25; use the price shown for the treatment you select. Sauna is booked separately from hands-on care. Check Square for availability and ask Matrix about standalone sauna appointments.

Private heat, clear timing and time to decompress.

Your provider reviews basic sauna use and timing before you settle into the session.

Radiant heat in a private setting.

Infrared sauna uses radiant heat to warm the body in a controlled environment. Individual tolerance varies, and guests should follow appropriate safety guidance.

Show the actual sauna, room and client-ready setup.

Infrared sauna questions, answered.

How long is the infrared sauna session?

Matrix currently lists a 30-minute infrared sauna option. Confirm the current booking menu when scheduling.

Can I combine sauna with massage or another service?

Sauna can be paired with selected Matrix services when timing and individual comfort allow. Contact Matrix if you want help planning the order of your appointments.

Is sauna a detox treatment?

Matrix offers infrared sauna for general wellness and relaxation. We do not present sweating or sauna use as a medical detox treatment.

Who should avoid sauna?

Heat exposure is not appropriate for everyone. If you are pregnant, have cardiovascular concerns, take medications that affect heat tolerance or have another medical concern, ask your healthcare professional before sauna use.

Where is Matrix located?

Matrix Massage & Bodywork is at 24804 75th St, Salem, WI 53168.

Book infrared sauna in Salem, Wisconsin.

Reserve through the Matrix booking menu or text 262-939-9325 if you want to combine sauna with another service.
